S2 and S3 are built and every check passes. The Features step lists findings as short rows. The .ipt groups fold under them, as in the mock-up you approved. Screens (tap to zoom)

Calls I made while building

  • A rule with its own sentence uses the plural form for several findings: "Inside corners have no radius" for 4, as the frame shows.
  • A passed row's sentence is its first check's words ("4.000 in thick, at least 0.030 in"), as the spec says. The frame's sample sentence ("Thinnest is…") isn't built; tap the row to see every wall.
  • The Passed chip counts features (9), as the frame does. The old "22 checks" total is gone; each passed row is one check.
  • Rows inside an opened .ipt group keep today's bordered look rather than the mock-up's flat rows.
  • The open row's advice reads "Fix" on a Fix row and "Suggestion" on a Review row, as on the mock-up.
  • Machining shows tool names only. Tool codes such as em-0.250 are gone from the screen (the PDF is unchanged).
  • A part with no machine plan (a block reviewed for Turning) lists its rows on Features only.
  • D-050: a hole is "square" when either open end meets a flat face within 0.5°, the same tolerance as the axes (an assumption). A hole with no flat face at its opening (on a round shaft) stays a Review.
